thread:
maya: Quick ask 10-min planning: we want a 'rapid-fire' SI onboarding sprint next month to validate the one-page play and voucher flow. Goal: onboard 8 partners in 2 days. Who owns the mini-runbook?

zara: I can draft the one-pager play. Will keep to: prereqs, lab booking, marketplace dry-run, cert gate, contacts.

samir: Ill do voucher automation and ops checklist. Plan: 8 single-day vouchers, ephemeral creds, pre-provisioned small H100 slot pool.

priyanka: Ill own cert gate + quick QA checklist. Recommend: 10-question quiz + 30-min lab practical. Pass = 70%.

ops-bot: Reminder: create event "SI rapid-fire onramp" Tue 09:00 PT. Event created.

zara: For the playbook, do we want a "lane" for marketplace-only partners vs. full-integrators? Keeps expectations clear.

maya: Yes. Two lanes: marketplace-only (30-60m) and integrator (2-3h). Note in playbook.

samir: Ops notes: include network allowlist template, ephemeral token TTL=12h, KMS cross-account ARN example. Sample token create (ops):
```
POST /internal/ephemeral-tokens
{ "ttl":43200, "scope":"sandbox:si" }
```

priyanka: Cert flow detail: auto-checker for smoke tests + manual review for listing correctness. We'll need two graders per cohort day.

zara: I'll add a tiny troubleshooting panel: common errors and one-line fixes (ECR perms, token expiry, bucket ACL).

maya: Partners: can we get partner ops contact windows for the two-days? Need phone/slack and a 4-hour overlap with our ops team.

partners-bot: Partners: RackTorch confirms support 9-5 PT, CloudNest can provide evening windows 6-11 PT, EdgeGrid pending.

samir: I'll reserve vouchers once partners confirm support windows. Also will add an emergency rollback step in playbook: revoke tokens + snapshot logs + open P0 channel.

zara: Draft one-pager target: Mon EOD. Can someone review quickly Tue morning?

maya: Ill review Tue AM. Priyanka and Samir pls quick-check cert/ops sections.

ops-bot: Reaction logged: :white_check_mark: event scheduled and reminders set.

priyanka: Tiny Q: do we allow partners to use their own CI during lab, or must they use sandbox-only flows? Policy?

maya: Sandbox-only for pilot. Add a note: "no prod CI or prod keys."

zara: Got it. Will include consent checkbox for data retention & NDA link.

maya: Nice. Action items: Zara = one-pager (Mon EOD), Samir = voucher + ops snippet (Tue), Priyanka = cert graders & rubric (Tue). Reconvene Tue 09:30 for preflight. :rocket:
